growth_protocol_ch1: All genetically-modified mouse lines utilized in this study have been previously described in the literature: these include lines containing a knock-in of a MerCreMer cDNA into either the Postn genomic loci (1), the Rosa26 reporter mice (R26eGFP) purchased from Jackson laboratories (Stock# 012429), and LoxP-targeted Hsp47 mice (3). Mice were administered pharmaceutical grade tamoxifen (100 mg/kg body weight, i.p.) dissolved in 95% peanut oil/ 5% ethanol twice  coupled with continuous feeding of tamoxifen-citrate chow (40 mg/kg body weight, Envigo - TD.130860) until termination of experiment. Eight to ten week-old control and HSP47-deficient mice were subjected to pressure overload by TAC surgery; effectiveness of the procedure was verified by Doppler echocardiography, via measurement of pressure-gradients across the aortic constriction.  Four weeks after TAC surgery interstitial cells were isolated from cardiac ventricles, as previously described (1). Flow cytometry analysis was performed on these cells using a Becton Dickinson FACSCanto II running FACSDiva software; for sorting of fibroblasts from Postn expressing lineages, endogenous eGFP fluorescence expressed by the recombined reporter allele was utilized. Count of GFP+ cells was normalized to number of CD31+ cells to ensure similar digestion of samples and to eliminate differences in total counts resulting from sample preparation variability.  1. Kanisicak O, et al. Genetic lineage tracing defines myofibroblast origin and function in the injured heart. Nat Commun. 2016;7:12260.  2. Acharya A, et al. Efficient inducible Cre-mediated recombination in Tcf21 cell lineages in the heart and kidney. Genesis. 2011;49:870-7.  3. Masago Y, Hosoya A, Kawasaki K, Kawano S, Nasu A, Toguchida J, et al. The molecular chaperone Hsp47 is essential for cartilage and endochondral bone formation. J Cell Sci. 2012;125(Pt 5):1118-28.

stop_claims.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the profiled samples differ only by Hsp47 genotype (all after TAC, none exercised). The treadmill test in the paper (S4.15.p1) is a dystrophy performance readout with no RNA-seq. The data cannot identify an exercise effect on gene expression.
